The '''HoloNet News Weather Report''' was a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] feature that provided 5-day forecasts for various planets in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], depending on the [[Planet Code]].

It was featured in the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
